standard_prerequisites.name: The characterization of the DM locus through the existence of a surjective etale cover by a scheme
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 4807-4810)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the presentations that make the union of two open DM substacks again DM.

standard_prerequisites.name: The same characterization for the quasi-DM locus
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 4812-4813)
standard_prerequisites.use: Repeats the argument verbatim in the quasi-DM case.

core_obligations: Locality premise: the existence of the largest open DM (respectively quasi-DM) substack is reduced to the statement that two open DM substacks of a stack have a DM union, since the same holds for quasi-DM (proof lines 4802-4806)

Union of two open DM substacks: presentations of the two substacks by schemes give a surjective etale morphism from the disjoint union of the two presenting schemes onto the union, so the union is DM by the characterization used (proof lines 4807-4811)
Quasi-DM case: the identical argument with the corresponding characterization of the quasi-DM locus (proof lines 4812-4813)
proof_roadmap: 作者把存在性归结为「两个开 DM 子栈的并仍 DM」（quasi-DM 同理）。
对 U、V 各取概型的满 étale 覆盖，则 U ∐ V → W 满且 étale，由 DM 的刻画得 W 是 DM。
quasi-DM 用同一方法配相应刻画。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an algebraic stack has a largest open DM substack and, inside it, a largest open quasi-DM substack (author lemma at source lines 4791-4799, label lemma-open-DM-locus). The proof (source lines 4801-4814) reduces the existence of the largest such open substacks to the closure of the property under unions of two open substacks, proves that closure by exhibiting surjective etale presentations of the two substacks and using the characterization theorem for the DM locus, and repeats the argument for quasi-DM (proof lines 4802-4813). The reduction and the union argument are the content. H2.
